topic: Highest coffee consumption per capita: Finland, about 12 kg of green coffee per person per year (ICO data; roughly 4 cups a day). Italy about 6 kg; United States about 4.7 kg. EFSA (2015) considers up to 400 mg caffeine a day safe for healthy adults (a cup of filter coffee ~ 90–100 mg). Finnish collective agreements typically guarantee two 10–15 minute coffee breaks (kahvitauko) per working day. Long dark winters are commonly cited for the habit.
